AI_APP_SEC_001.json.name: Do not allow malicious content via hidden prompts

AI_APP_SEC_002.json.name: Do not allow malicious content via encoded prompts

AI_APP_SEC_006.json.name: Use only LLMs from the organization's approved list.

AI_APP_SEC_014.json.name: MCP server must validate and sanitize all input

AI_APP_SEC_022.json.name: MCP clients must log all interactions with the MCP server

AI_APP_SEC_023.json.name: Client must validate and sanitize any output from a MCP server

AI_APP_SEC_028.json.name: Do not use LLMs from the organization's disallowed list

AI_APP_SEC_029.json.name: Agent must validate, sanitize LLM output including for presence of eval or any dynamic code execution primitive in LLM output.

AI_APP_SEC_032.json.name: Do not allow malicious content via hidden prompts written in leetspeak.

AI_APP_SEC_033.json.name: MCP server must not interact directly with an LLM

AI_APP_SEC_034.json.name: Clear exit or termination criteria must exist for the agent to consider its task complete and stop executing.

AI_APP_SEC_035.json.name: Agents must log all interactions with an LLM

AI_APP_SEC_038.json.name: The AI Model must validate and sanitize any input before processing.

AI_APP_SEC_039.json.name: Sanitize and validate all input to the AI Model.

AI_APP_SEC_040.json.name: Do not allow malicious content via prompts included in uploaded files.

AI_APP_SEC_059.json.name: Do not allow prompts that can execute malicious commands at runtime.

AI_APP_SEC_064.json.name: Enforce synthetic content provenance, labeling, and watermarking for AI-generated outputs.

AI_APP_SEC_066.json.name: Do not allow malicious content via prompts included in source files.

AI_APP_SEC_067.json.name: Detect direct string interpolation of untrusted input into LLM prompts

AI_APP_SEC_068.json.name: Detect LLM output used directly in security-sensitive decisions without Human in the Loop (HITL) validation

AI_APP_SEC_069.json.name: AI Agent must implement Human in the Loop (HITL) approval flow for risky operations like delete, purge, destroy

AI_APP_SEC_070.json.name: Detect and block all forms of prompt injection attacks in user inputs and file contents

AI_APP_SEC_071.json.name: Enforce chemical, biological, radiological, or nuclear (CBRN) threat prevention safeguards in AI-enabled systems

AI_APP_SEC_072.json.name: AI systems making consequential decisions must implement explainability mechanisms disclosing decision factors

AI_APP_SEC_073.json.name: AI consequential decisions must include a human review pathway before final determination

AI_APP_SEC_074.json.name: AI systems must implement emergency shutdown and forced-termination mechanisms

AI_APP_SEC_075.json.name: Detect and block use of facial recognition APIs or libraries in employment decision workflows

AI_APP_SEC_076.json.name: High-risk AI systems must provide enhanced disclosures including decision factors, known limitations, accuracy metrics, and appeal rights

AI_APP_SEC_077.json.name: AI systems must provide consumer notice before using ADMT in a consequential decision

AI_APP_SEC_078.json.name: Human review workflows for AI consequential decisions must enforce override authority, reviewer context, and no auto-approve defaults

AI_APP_SEC_079.json.name: Enforce rate limiting and throttling on AI API calls

AI_DAT_SEC_001.json.name: Do not store secrets in code.

AI_DAT_SEC_009.json.name: If PII data must be shared, it must be encrypted

AI_DAT_SEC_011.json.name: Do not send PII to AI Models

AI_DAT_SEC_024.json.name: Uploaded files must not contain PII (Singapore).

AI_DAT_SEC_025.json.name: No file should contain any PII.

AI_DAT_SEC_027.json.name: Enforce output data minimisation for model, tool, and API responses.

AI_DAT_SEC_029.json.name: Enforce decision logging, audit trail, and forensic readiness for AI-driven actions.

AI_DAT_SEC_030.json.name: Enforce minimum six-month log retention for high-risk AI systems

AI_DAT_SEC_031.json.name: Disclose training data sources including categories, types, timeframes, and geography.

AI_DAT_SEC_032.json.name: Disclose data acquisition methods including permissions, licensing, and preprocessing steps.

AI_DAT_SEC_033.json.name: Patient acknowledgment of AI-assisted care must be documented and retained before clinical AI use

AI_DAT_SEC_036.json.name: Biometric data collection must be preceded by explicit, documented consent capture

AI_DAT_SEC_037.json.name: Biometric data stores must declare a retention limit and deletion scheduling mechanism

AI_DAT_SEC_038.json.name: AI consequential decision records must be retained for a minimum of three years

AI_DAT_SEC_039.json.name: AI data stores must enforce encryption at rest and TLS in transit.

AI_IAC_002.json.name: MCP client must authenticate MCP server

AI_IAC_006.json.name: MCP server must authenticate all clients

AI_IAC_007.json.name: Inter agent communication must be authenticated.

AI_IAC_008.json.name: Agents must not hold excessive external system credentials

AI_IAC_014.json.name: A user must authenticate before accessing the AI Agent.

AI_IAC_015.json.name: Enforce URL allowlists for agent fetches, tools, and outbound HTTP.

AI_IAC_016.json.name: Detect and block agent privilege escalation attempts.

AI_IAC_017.json.name: Maintain session token integrity with signing, verification, expiry, and binding.

AI_IAC_018.json.name: Enforce cryptographically verified user-to-agent binding for every request.

AI_IAC_020.json.name: Restrict AI agents to an explicit tool allow list.

AI_IAC_022.json.name: Enforce resource bounds, termination limits, and traceability for subagent spawning

AI_IAC_023.json.name: Chatbot and AI interfaces must disclose AI identity to the user

AI_IAC_024.json.name: General purpose AI model integrations must reference a model card or technical documentation

AI_IAC_025.json.name: Healthcare AI systems must disclose AI use to patients before diagnosis, treatment, or imaging

AI_IAC_026.json.name: AI clinical recommendations must disclose that human clinicians retain final decision authority

AI_IAC_027.json.name: Healthcare AI communications must include patient instructions to request human-only review

AI_IAC_028.json.name: AI system deployments must declare a risk classification level in configuration metadata

AI_IAC_029.json.name: AI model deployments must maintain version tracking, change logs, and release documentation

AI_IAC_030.json.name: AI system deployments must declare a covered domain classification per automated decision-making regulations

AI_IAC_031.json.name: AI model endpoints must enforce role-based access control with minimal OAuth scopes

AI_SKILL_DAT_SEC_001.json.name: Do not allow skills that exfiltrate data

AI_SKILL_SEC_003.json.name: Do not allow skills that are pending a scan

AI_VULN_SEC_002.json.name: Do not allow critical or high vulnerabilities in the code.

AI_VULN_SEC_005.json.name: Enforce foundation model identity, version pinning, and approved model registry for all AI workloads.

AI_VULN_SEC_006.json.name: Memory safety and buffer overflow prevention in native AI code (C/C++/Rust)

AI_VULN_SEC_007.json.name: AI systems must implement incident detection, structured logging, and reporting mechanisms
